meta.name: Hibrid 360 — Service Chapter DNA
meta.description: Design DNA for the 7 What We Do service pages. Distilled from the client-approved references and adapted to the locked Hibrid 360 brand system (CLAUDE.md): black ground, white + yellow text balance, fuchsia as helper colour, Montserrat + Inter. Companion spec: docs/design/SERVICE_CHAPTER_SYSTEM.md.
source_references: STRV — Branding and Website Redesign (image): hairline rule + label at rule end, vertical micro labels, short rule before the lede, tonal contrast inside a headline, giant glyph with bezier handles (design-tool annotation as graphic language)
Gareth Hughes — Creative Director (image): a single luminous form in a black void, label column + narrow text column, restraint
MAG Design (image): services set as flowing giant words with superscript indices; hover blurs the rest and glitches the focused word
ORION Digital Marketing Agency (image): coordinates micro text in the meta row, outline pill labels, split columns with vertical hairlines, line-art arrows
Black services list (image): big sentence opened by an inline micro label, /01 index rows with hairline dividers
MONOLOG — bymonolog.com (Awwwards SOTD 6 Jul 2026): two-colour restraint (#080807 / #DDDDD5), statement hero, cinematic CTA, GSAP split/reveal/sticky
Madrepunk Studio — madrepunk.com (Awwwards HM Jun 2026): near-black + one electric accent (#040014 / #D4FE00), WebGL slider, microinteractions
Cipher — cipher.tv (Awwwards SOTD 20 Aug 2026): monochrome #060403, video-led sections, page transitions

color.palette_type: monochromatic black ground with a dual accent (yellow voice + fuchsia tool)

primary.role: Narration — title carriers, body copy, service names. Token --color-brand-white.

secondary.role: Voice / focus — exactly one yellow focal per composition (slogan, key phrase, active or hovered state). Token --color-brand-yellow (Pantone 803 C).

accent.role: Tool / helper — hairline graphics, selection frames and handles, bezier anchors, small indices (01, 000°), degree marker, hover glitch, focus ring, cursor. Never body or heading text. Token --color-brand-fuchsia (Pantone 806 C).

neutral.usage: White = primary text (21:1). 55% = secondary text, token --text-muted (6.2:1, AA). 40% = display-size text only (3.7:1, AA-large). 14% = hairlines, new token --color-hairline. Black = the only ground.

semantic.success: n/a on service chapters — no form states; site form tokens apply elsewhere
semantic.info: Pending/status rows use a fuchsia dot + --text-muted label (e.g. common.pendingLabel)

surface.card: #000000 — no cards; sections are separated by hairlines, not containers
surface.elevated: #000000 — no raised surfaces; depth comes from pinned stages and clip-path windows

color.contrast_strategy: Maximum contrast on pure black: white 21:1, yellow 19.2:1, fuchsia 6.7:1 (graphics and indices only). No full-screen colour fields (user decision 2026-09-13). White on fuchsia (3.1:1) is forbidden.
color.palette_ratio: black ≥60% · white ~30% · yellow ~8% · fuchsia ~2% of each viewport's area

heading_1.size: var(--chapter-display) (the hero h1 is the display line)

body_small.size: var(--font-size-lead) — 18 / 20 / 22px (used for ledes, set in Montserrat 600)

font_families.heading: Montserrat (self-hosted variable 300–800, public/fonts/montserrat-latin-tr.woff2)
font_families.mono: none — numerals set in Montserrat; the subset has no tnum, so numeric columns use a fixed min-width

typography.font_style_notes: Geometric sans display in 800 uppercase at architectural scale. The references' condensed faces (STRV, ORION) and serifs (Gareth Hughes, the italic /01 index) are deliberately not adopted because the brand is locked to Montserrat + Inter; impact comes from scale and white/yellow tonal contrast instead. A 300↔800 weight contrast is available as an existing house device. Measured widths (Montserrat 800, em): CREATIVITY 6.251, WITHOUT LIMITS 9.012, WITHOUT 5.201, LIMITS 3.521, PRODUCTION 7.272, MANAGEMENT 7.831.

spacing.section_rhythm: Each chapter section is at least one viewport or a pinned scene (160–240svh). Sections open with a 1px hairline + label; interior gaps use --space-8 / --space-12 / --space-16.

layout.grid_system: 12-column editorial grid with a left rail
layout.max_content_width: none — full-bleed with --page-gutter; prose capped at --measure-prose (54ch)

border_radius.large: 0 (the film window starts at 4px and resolves to 0 at full bleed)
border_radius.pill: 999px (site pill buttons elsewhere; not used inside chapters)

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px — hairlines in --color-hairline; fuchsia 1px only for tool UI
shape.divider_style: full-width 1px hairline with a left h2 label and a right count, e.g. SERVICES ……… (10)

elevation.depth_cues: overlapping layers — pinned stages, clip-path windows, films behind type; plus scale contrast

iconography.preferred_set: lucide-react for controls (Pause/Play, arrows) + bespoke inline SVG instruments (selection frame, pen tool, 360° dial)

motion.easing: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) — new token --ease-house (already hand-written 11× in the codebase)

duration_scale.macro: 720ms (load sequences ≤ 1.4s total; scroll scenes are scrubbed, not timed)

motion.entrance_pattern: mask rise (translateY 100% → 0 inside an overflow clip), edge draw (scale 0 → 1), handle pop (scale), scroll-scrubbed reveals
motion.exit_pattern: none on scroll — scenes hold their final state; hover states reverse in 180ms
motion.philosophy: Cinematic but disciplined: one engineered peak per page, at least four motion families, never the same device twice in a row; reduced motion shows every final state.

components.button_style: No in-page primary buttons — the global CtaBand owns the single CTA. Text links in Montserrat 700 uppercase with an arrow; hover turns yellow.
components.navigation_pattern: Degree meta row at the top (hub link / service / 000° + dial); a Next row at the bottom that rotates to the next service's degree; site header and footer unchanged
components.list_style: Flowing inline giant words with superscript fuchsia indices (MAG reference), not bullets
components.component_notes: Shared: ChapterHero, ChapterRule, ChapterDial, ChapterFilm, ChapterVideo, ScrollLitText, ChapterIndex, ChapterStrip, ChapterNext. Per page: one instrument SVG (Creative = selection frame + pen-tool DNA helix).

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: The designer's workspace at night — selection frames, bezier handles and a 360° dial on a black artboard. Every service is one degree of the same circle.
aesthetic.era_influence: Swiss editorial grid × contemporary Awwwards agency sites (2025–26) × print/DTP tool UI (Illustrator, InDesign)
aesthetic.genre: luxury editorial agency / dark cinematic portfolio
personality_traits: playful in detail, serious in structure

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents — only functional tool-UI graphics
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous black negative space; at least 60% of every viewport is ground
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Left-weighted display type balanced by right-column ledes; full-bleed films carry mid-page weight
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element per screen (the one yellow focal)
visual_language.texture_usage: None in the UI; texture lives inside the films (sequins, mirror facets, grain)

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast + colour weight (yellow marks focus)
composition.flow_direction: top-down with horizontal escapes (overset headline, helix drawing left to right)
composition.negative_space_role: Active — it frames the single idea on each screen and lets the films breathe

imagery.photo_treatment: No stock photography. AI-generated cinematic loops (Seedance 2.5) in a black void with magenta/yellow practical light, crushed blacks and fine grain, labelled with video.aiGenerated.
imagery.illustration_style: Technical hairline vector (tool UI): anchors, handles, frames, ticks
graphic_elements: selection frame with 8 handles + overset '+' port
360° dial with 72 ticks and a degree marker
imagery.image_shape: full-bleed rectangles; a 16:9 window expanding to full bleed; 21:9 strips

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate colour shift to yellow with subtle motion
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Index: siblings dim and blur, the hovered word turns yellow with a 360ms RGB-split glitch (fuchsia/white). Next row: the dial rotates 45°.
interaction_feel.loading_style: CSS-only hero sequence (≤ 1.4s); films lazy-load near the viewport with the poster first

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: confident, brief, slogan-led (English slogans are brand language on TR pages too)
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Honest pending status with approved copy (e.g. services.creative.galleryEmpty) — never fake work

overview.fallback_strategy: prefers-reduced-motion → static final states (CSS, before JS); no JS → readable final content via var(--progress, default); films → poster
overview.primary_technology: CSS custom properties driven by one rAF scroll hook (--progress) + inline SVG; no animation libraries, no WebGL

background_effects.description: Film sections only: a 16:9 loop inside a window that expands to full bleed, and a 21:9 strip. The page ground is always flat black.
background_effects.technology: HTML5 video — AV1 WebM (10-bit) + H.264 MP4 fallback, preload=none, play in view

particle_systems.description: Any light-fleck or texture motion lives inside the page's single film asset; there is no runtime particle system

3d_elements.description: No real-time 3D. The site's single-WebGL-scene quota belongs to the homepage hero.

trigger_points: film window — pinned 220svh (mobile 160svh), clip inset scrubbed 0 → 1
manifesto — pass progress 0.15–0.70 lights words in order
index — pass progress drives a spotlight on touch devices
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: direct scrub via --progress (no inertia, no smoothing)

scroll_morphing.description: The 16:9 film window morphs to full bleed through clip-path inset — no DOM reflow

text_effects.description: Hero lines rise from masks on load; manifesto words light up with scroll; index words glitch (RGB split) on hover
text_effects.technology: CSS keyframes + custom properties on server-rendered spans

params.animation_per_unit: opacity 0.4 → 1 per word; translateY 100% → 0 per line
params.stagger: scroll-linked (word i lights at progress i/n); load stagger 30–90ms
params.effect_style: editorial reading light; 360ms steps(3) glitch in fuchsia/white

cursor_effects.description: Existing site cursor: a fuchsia degree glyph ° following the pointer with a lerp — it is the origin of the 360° concept. The system cursor is never hidden.

params.interaction_zone: global; disabled for touch and reduced motion

image_effects.description: Films are revealed by clip-path window expansion; strips play only while in view

params.filter_pipeline: none (the grade is baked into the film)
params.reveal_animation: clip-path inset expansion scrubbed by scroll

canvas_drawings.description: No canvas — vector instruments are inline SVG

svg_animations.description: Creative DNA helix: two bezier strands draw via stroke-dashoffset (pathLength=1) while fuchsia anchors and handles appear at thresholds and a pen cursor rides the tip. The hero selection frame draws its edges on load, then its handles and edges breathe continuously (low-amplitude opacity loop) so the frame reads as an active tool, not a static, possibly-broken box. The 360° dial rotates on hover.

params.animation_method: CSS custom properties (--draw derived from --progress) + CSS keyframes on load

visual_effects.composite_notes: Colour was not measured: the five reference images exist only in the conversation (not on disk) and the palette is brand-locked by CLAUDE.md, so the references contribute structure, typography behaviour, motion and composition — not colour. The references' own palettes (MONOLOG #080807/#DDDDD5, Madrepunk #040014/#D4FE00, Cipher #060403) confirm the two-colour-plus-one-accent discipline that the Hibrid palette already follows. Effects layer as: black ground → films (the only texture) → hairline tool UI in fuchsia → white/yellow type. Performance: a single passive scroll listener per in-view scene, compositor-only properties (clip-path, transform, opacity, stroke-dashoffset); films are the only heavy assets and load lazily.
